text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Pokke! With my dance, let the wind be at 
your back! Accept this... "Sword Dance"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Uoooh! Get lost, you damn 
monsters!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaahhh~... Perfect sync! Master and 
disciple, so precious, so blessed~~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The beginning of this fantasy adventure 
goes back a few hours—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Recruiting testers for a new RPG"? Heh, 
sounds pretty damn fun.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"6 people per team", huh... Oh, hey there, 
Digital and Trainer! That makes two party 
members secured, come along!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyoeh!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I-I just tagged along as told... To think 
I'd be blessed with such good fortune...!)
choice_data_list: Um, should we choose our classes first?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Hyoehh~...! Pirate Tap-san and Alchemist 
Tachyon-san...! Good, so good! It suits 
them so well~...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And over here is— Dancer Fuji-san and 
Brawler Pokke-san... Nfufu♪)
choice_data_list: Um, what are you going to pick?
Um, what are you going to pick?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? M-Me...? Well, honestly, I would love 
to just be a wall watching over everyone's 
glorious exploits, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Wall" isn't... a selectable job. So I'll 
go with a support Thief,...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All right! It's started! Let's get right 
into it, Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, full of spirit, aren't you? Where 
should we head first—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion! Oh, there's 
something in this jar... Hraah!
choice_data_list:
Smashing barrels and pots right off the 
bat!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san, there was a recovery item inside 
the pot! All riiight... I'm gonna go 
search for some more treasure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Gh! ...Ghhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(So blessed, that smile. That pure face 
determined to be of use to her master! 
Must protect, I must protect it... Wait, 
idea!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Dots on the map... Was this always 
here? ...Well, let's go check it out 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(...Skill: "Treasure Scent". Keep up that 
momentum and have a safe trip, 
Pokke-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We gathered plenty of items, but still... 
I really wanna change our gear too. Can't 
stay in starting gear forever, right?
choice_data_list:
We could buy some if we save up money, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...About that. We actually have quite a 
bit saved up. Strangely enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Thief passive trait: "Uma Gold Farming". 
I'm so glad to be of service...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... Am I being a good wall? Once we 
pass through that door, it's the first 
boss...! Good luck, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gwaaagh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Hey, you alright, Pokke...!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right back atcha... Haha, dammit. Guess it 
really earned the title of boss. The 
weight of its blow is in a whole different 
league from standard mobs.
choice_data_list:
How many medicinal herbs did we have 
left...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Awawawa, p-p-pinch!? Is this party lacking 
a dedicated healer, by any chance!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That said, a Thief is hardly a healer 
either... Ah, but still! At this rate, 
everyone is going to...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Screw it, whatever happens, happens!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...!? What's this? Suddenly my body feels 
lighter...!
choice_data_list: The damage is recovering on its own...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh no, it's hardly happening "on its 
own."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Nuooohhh~...! Hang in there, Digi-tan's 
legs and arms...!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Quickly! "Steal" medicinal herbs! "Use"! 
"Steal"! "Use"~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Roar, Thief agility~~! I won't let 
Pokke-san suffer any painーー!!)
choice_data_list: Using Thief speed to act as a healer!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, how dependable. Now's the time, 
let's go, Pokke! "Miracle Duo Dance"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ousu! Take this!! "Raging Battle Roar"!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Ahhh, this is what I lived to see...! 
Thank you, ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Heheh, that's one win down!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot, Digital. You're real 
versatile, ain't ya!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Appearing like the wind to come to 
everyone's aid... Yes, a performance truly 
worthy of being called a chivalrous thief!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
!? A-Ahhh, um... I'm just a wall... please 
don't perceive meee... guh.
